payload.body:
## Problem and change

First-hit probability and renewal count differ after reset. Add the finite-horizon shifted first-passage series for F/G/M/J, active/refractory occupation and a single final terminal payoff, with explicit domain and cancellation checks.

## Validation and limits

The complete frozen source snapshot (archive SHA-256 `353f7c0f50d187adeccbd1fff0638d1a649fe2c547c03ebf23e3fceafa846ff8`) passed 71/71 native CPU FP64 tests and all four declared numerical-budget fixtures. Source hashes matched before and after execution. Intermediate stack commits are review units; they are not separately executed qualifications.

The first 64-cell budget failure remains in the evidence. The 128-cell profile passed the original limits; this does not qualify the default grid or the entire trainable parameter domain. Formal real-task fits: 0. Physical energy: unmeasured. Endogenous optimal boundary: unsolved.

This is draft stage 2/7 above the existing unmerged HCSN stack. CI is intentionally not launched on this intermediate review unit; no skipped-job credit is claimed. The final evidence PR supplies the complete tree for actual checks. No merge, force update, main change or frozen-study mutation is included.
